ValidationRule.description: CIC Frontline Agent, Specialist,FOS,CIC Bottler user should be able to enter "Other Purchase Location" only if "Point Of Purchase" is filled as " Other".
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName == "NA_Non_Quality", RecordType.DeveloperName == "NA_Quality"), Point_of_Purchase__r.Name <> "Other", Not(Other_Purchase_Location__c = '' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are allowed to enter Other Purchase Location only if Purchase location is selected as "Other".
